thread:
maria: quick design huddle re: scorecard + approval flow for prompt-set evals. got feedback from beta reviewers: the scorecard legend is dense and approval flow feels risky for keyboard-first reviewers. attaching mock: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz

rachel: main pain: when you tab through the scorecard the radio matrix is long and you can't see which criterion is currently pinned to the header. suggestion: pin the criterion label as you scroll and show a condensed indicator ("3/8 criteria").

sam: yes on pinned label. also the binary/scale mix is confusing. can we standardize to a 1-5 scale and derive binary decisions from thresholds (>=4 = pass) so reviewers don't switch mental models?

devin: UX for bulk-approve from a scorecard run: current modal says "Approve run" and does the action immediately. recommendation: change modal copy to "Approve all items meeting thresholds" and show exact counts per status (Accept / Needs Work / Fail) with ability to exclude categories. reduces accidental approvals.

alex: A11y notes: 1) scorecard grid needs keyboard accessible headers with aria-sort for column sorters. 2) radio groups need aria-labelledby and instructions: "Use arrow keys to move within criteria". 3) color blind mode: don't rely on red/green, add patterns or icons (✓, !, ×).

maria: microcopy tweak: change per-item action CTA from "Accept" to "Mark as accepted" — verbs reduce ambiguity. Also for the top-level bulk button: "Approve selected items" not "Approve run".

rachel: keyboard flow problem: after bulk-approve, focus returns to top of page; keyboard users can't find the next unreviewed item. proposal: on completion, move focus to the first unreviewed row or to a summary toast with link "Go to next".
sam: undo behaviour: current toast disappears in 6s. make it 10s and include keyboard shortcut hint `z` (e.g., "Approved — Undo (z)"). track metric `scorecard_undo_rate`.
devin: data suggestion: show small per-criterion histograms inline so reviewers understand distribution (sparklines). keep them very subtle to avoid clutter.
alex: contrast callout: the faint gray used for "needs review" chips is 3:1 borderline. bump to 4.5:1 when text appears on top. For focus ring, prefer `box-shadow` over outline to avoid jarring layout shifts.
maria: interaction nuance: when reviewer edits a score in-place, it currently commits immediately and collapses the comment area. prefer inline draft state so they can enter score + comment and commit together. show a small "Save" affordance.
rachel: copy for empty scorecard state: prefer "No items in this run yet" over "0 results". friendlier tone.
sam: tiny CSS POC for pinned header + focus ring:
```css
.scorecard-criterion--pinned { position: sticky; top: 0; background: var(--panel-bg); padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.04); }
.row:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(26,115,232,0.12); }
```

aria-bot: ticket UX-812 created: "scorecard accessibility and bulk-approval safeguards" assigned to @maria, labels: design, product, accessibility.

maria: ok action items: 1) I'll update Figma to show: standardized 1-5 scale, pinned criterion header, per-criterion histograms, and revised bulk modal copy; 2) alex run contrast and keyboard checklist; 3) devin spec the bulk-exclude flow and undo telemetry; 4) sam prototype keyboard focus navigation. I'll post updated mock images here in ~3 hours. ping me if you want to pair before then. :slightly_smiling_face:
